text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With all of Symboli Rudolf's races<n>over, now is as
good a time as any to<n>reflect on her achievements.
choice_data_list:
I never dreamed you'd claim more than seven
crowns!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even I am astonished by the<n>magnitude of what I
have<n>accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But it is you who deserves the credit.<n>None of this
would have been<n>possible without your unfailing
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. You have made<n>me the
swiftest Umamusume there<n>ever was.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I should thank my lucky stars that I<n>chose you that
day... Or perhaps I<n>should say that you chose me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, it is thanks to—wait, I see where<n>this is going.
At this rate, we will be<n>complimenting one another
all day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us call it a draw and say that wewere both responsible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, I do believe we've earned<n>ourselves
something of a reward,<n>wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Something worthy of commemorating<n>this
monumental feat.
choice_data_list: What could live up to that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Struggling for ideas? Well, truth be<n>told, so am I.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Thinking of gifts for oneself<n>isn't easy, is
it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But fortunately, we have a great deal<n>of time. If we
put our heads together,<n>I'm certain we'll succeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not least because time spent with you<n>is as much
of a reward as any.
